query:
SELECT
                id        AS "id!: Uuid",
                order_id  AS "order_id!: Uuid",
                side      AS "side!",
                price     AS "price!: Decimal",
                quantity  AS "quantity!: Decimal",
                fee       AS "fee!: Decimal",
                fee_asset AS "fee_asset!",
                market_ts AS "market_ts!: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>"
            FROM fills_backtest
            WHERE run_id = $1
              AND market_ts >= $2
              AND market_ts < $3
            ORDER BY market_ts ASC
            LIMIT $4
